rows.text: The LDP reports that 安倍晋三総理・総裁 announced his resignation (辞任を表明) on 12 September 2007.

locator.section: date line 【平成１９年 ９月１２日】; headline 総裁選の日程を協議 総裁選管理委員会; first sentence

rows.text: The same day the party decided, citing Article 6(2) of the party rules (党則第６条第２項), to choose the president at a joint plenary meeting held in place of the party convention; the presidential election administration committee confirmed that evening that an open election would be held quickly.
